process_findings.text: section 13 artifact store: raw/run.jsonl (254,691 B) and raw/run131101.jsonl (89,012 B) are .jsonl over 64 KiB committed to Git, no .artifacts.json, bench record raw uploaded=false; the binary lives only at a scratch path (binary.sha256)

section 5a w_cal is not recorded; the pair's order does not depend on it: nofb is no costlier than sge in every counted component on all 80 pairs, so the order holds at every w >= 0, including w_cal and 10 w_cal

section 3a cost chain not written in RESULTS.md; its premise holds: the only differing fields on the 15 fallback pairs are the fallback's Wiedemann splits (spmv, bm, vec), its failed certificate (group_ops, cantor_mul, cantor_inv) and the two fallback counters

frozen analyze.py: C0 reads with .get; completeness against the seeds.json panel is not checked; the pair-identity check compares a subset of fields; IC/rho uses runs.get. No effect here: 160 of 160 runs present, every key exists, all fields equal on the 65 no-fallback pairs

seeds.json against docs/experiment-seeds.md: master_seed is null; two seeded streams on the study path are not listed (BSGS order computation, quartic_ladder.rs:1241, curve_seed ^ 0xB5B5_0DD5_0DD5_B5B5; sampled factor base, quartic_ladder.rs:1888, 0x5AFB_0000_0000_0000 ^ q); the solver stream StdRng::seed_from_u64(solver_seed) is not keyed by instance or domain-separated (declared as inherited); derived seeds are not retained. Pairing and arm exclusion are correct and the replay is byte-identical
